activities.name: Public Health Awareness Campaign at Local Clinic

rationale.intuition: Brown overall ~5.2%, RD ~4.5%. Pell-eligible (low-income, federal aid threshold ~$60k household income) is a real but small contextual hook at need-blind schools — Brown is need-blind for domestic and meets full demonstrated need. Pell-eligible enrollment ~17% of class per Brown CDS H-section. No verified-flag exists in our profile schema (no `isPellEligible` field), so this fixture's hook signal must come from indirect proxies: 25 hr/wk work activity (signals socioeconomic context) + Horatio Alger Scholar award (explicitly recognizes low-income leadership). Counselor consensus 4-13% for strong unhooked-but-socioeconomically-disadvantaged applicant; contextual lift ~1.2× over baseline.

sources.name: Brown CDS 2024-25 (H-section)
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 5.18%; Pell-eligible students ~17% of undergraduate enrollment; Brown is need-blind for domestic, need-aware for intl.

sources.name: Brown Office of Financial Aid 2024
sources.evidence: Brown commits to meeting 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students; need-blind admission for domestic applicants includes Pell-eligible status.

sources.name: Common App Socioeconomic Context Report 2024
sources.evidence: Pell-eligible applicants at need-blind T20 see ~1.15-1.30× admit rate over similar non-Pell peers, driven primarily by contextual review of essay narratives + work-history activities.

sources.name: Crimson SES Hook Report 2024
sources.evidence: Strong unhooked applicants with explicit low-income markers (work hours, low-income-leadership awards) cluster 5-12% admit at T20 need-blind schools — small contextual lift above baseline.

wontFix.reason: Engine has no `isPellEligible` / `lowIncome` / household-income profile field, so any direct SES modeling is impossible. The only indirect signal is the WORK-category activity (25 hr/wk job) and the Horatio Alger Scholar award — and engine's activity/award scoring does NOT yet flag these as SES-context proxies. Result: engine will produce a baseline-RD probability (~4-5%) without contextual lift. Spec lower bound (4%) matches engine baseline, so fixture should pass at the floor; upper bound documents counselor intuition.
wontFix.followUp: Decide whether to add an explicit `isPellEligible` profile field (opt-in, same launch policy as urmStatus) OR upgrade activity/award scoring to detect SES-context proxies (WORK >20 hr/wk, low-income-leadership awards like Horatio Alger / QuestBridge / Coca-Cola). Prefer indirect detection because direct income disclosure raises privacy concerns.
